compiled_state.title: As an agent designing government benefit flows, I can query gov-benefit-flows UX patterns (one-question-per-page, task lists, review pages, SNAP lifecycle) from the corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Populate the gov-benefit-flows domain partition of the UI/UX reference corpus with government benefit application form patterns and policy context, covering sub-domains (a) and (b) from SC-4.

**Why**: SC-4 specifies gov-benefit-flows as one of the eight required content domains. No existing child story covers this domain. The corpus must include one-question-per-page patterns, multi-step task lists, review pages, validation errors, status pages, and SNAP lifecycle context before downstream skill files can reference these patterns.

**Scope**:
- IN: gov-benefit-flows domain Markdown files covering: one-question-per-page template and sub-patterns (repeatable items, stacking, looping, people list, someone-else option, I-dont-know option, grouping, optional answer); multi-step task list; review page patterns; validation/error messages; claim/application status page; document upload; confirmation/e-signature; draft/resume; SNAP lifecycle policy context; paid leave and employer dashboard patterns; docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registration for benefit delivery sources
- OUT: Any other domain

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the gov-benefit-flows domain partition contains >=10 schema-valid entries covering: one-question-per-page template, multi-step task list, review page patterns, validation/error messages, and claim/application status patterns
  <- Satisfies: sc-4  (sub-domain (a): Government benefit application form patterns)

- When this story is complete, the gov-benefit-flows domain contains >=1 policy-context entry covering SNAP lifecycle stages (application, verification, eligibility, recertification, reporting)
  <- Satisfies: sc-4  (sub-domain (b): Government benefit policy context)

- When this story is complete, all entries are schema-valid with required fields: rule_id, prior_art, precedence, and domain: gov-benefit-flows
  <- Satisfies: sc-1  (schema enforcement)

- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh gov-benefit-flows "one question per page" returns >=1 result
  <- Satisfies: sc-4

- When this story is complete, docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registers benefit delivery sources including navapbc/benefits-delivery-system (type: github-repo-private, credentials_required: true, access: internal-nava) with a note about credentials provisioning
  <- Satisfies: sc-7

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked.
